## Natural history notes

A medium-sized tiger moth characterized by bright white wings, a white furry body, and small black spots that may be present or nearly absent depending on the individual. In Florida, it is found in gardens, fields, roadsides, parks, forest edges, wetlands, and other open or semi-open habitats with herbaceous plants. Adults are mostly nocturnal and may come to lights, while the fuzzy “yellow woolly bear” caterpillars feed on many low plants, including grasses, clover, plantain, dandelion, and other weeds or garden plants.
